questionText:
Arrange the following post-independence developments in Indian Agriculture in chronological order.
(A) Intensive Agricultural District Programme
(B) Green Revolution
(D) Agro-climatic Planning
(C) National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 India: People and Economy (Chapter 4: Land Resources and Agriculture, 'Strategy of Agricultural Development'): (A) Intensive Agricultural District Programme (IADP) launched in 1960-61; (B) Green Revolution (introduction of Mexican semi-dwarf wheat and HYVs) introduced in the mid-1960s (1966-67); (D) Agro-climatic planning initiated by the Planning Commission in 1988 (Seventh Plan); (C) National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA) launched as part of the National Action Plan on Climate Change in 2014-15. Chronological order: (A) -> (B) -> (D) -> (C).
Hence, option (D) is correct.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: Open-cast mining carries severe occupational hazards of toxic gas asphyxiation and roof collapse.
Statement II: Shaft mining requires specialized vertical lifts, haulage vehicles, and air ventilation systems.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid scientific statements erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is false while Statement II is factually sound.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is false: toxic gases, flooding, and roof collapse are hazards of deep shaft (underground) mining, not open-cast mining. Statement II is correct: shaft mining requires elaborate vertical lifts and ventilation.
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
